sentences.zh: 保持学习，不断成长，多和别人交流经验，多问问题。

sentences.en: That's the process.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个过程。

sentences.en: It's just, you are like a sponge, because you just want to absorb everything to keep checking whether it's what you want to do, to keep learning about
sentences.zh: 你就像一块海绵，因为你只想吸收一切，来不断检验这是否是你想要做的事，不断了解

sentences.en: the different areas of psychology that exist and the different ways of working.
sentences.zh: 心理学中不同的领域以及不同的工作方式。

sentences.en: And if you feel like you're hitting that wall, then that's the point, isn't it, to step back and kind of
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己撞了南墙，那这就是关键所在，对吧？退后一步，然后

sentences.en: reassess, and maybe take a different step or a different action forward, but keep learning.
sentences.zh: 重新评估，或许采取不同的步骤或行动，但要继续学习。

sentences.en: So, so important.
sentences.zh: 真的，真的太重要了。

sentences.en: We don't stop learning.
sentences.zh: 我们不能停止学习。

sentences.en: And it's kind of coming back to the earlier point that we said, that's the benefit of CPD.
sentences.zh: 这有点回到我们刚才提到的早前那一点，这就是持续专业发展（CPD）的好处。

sentences.en: CPD, that's the benefit of talking to people with networking, liaising.
sentences.zh: CPD，这就是交流、人脉和联络带来的好处。

sentences.en: You just learn so much about how we can help people differently.
sentences.zh: 你能学到那么多关于如何以不同方式帮助别人的知识。

sentences.en: And I think that's the great opportunity of this work.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是这项工作最棒的机遇。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: We've got our placards out.
sentences.zh: 我们的标语都亮出来了。

sentences.en: But this is what I want for people.
sentences.zh: 但这正是我对大家的期望。

sentences.en: So whoever they are, whoever, whatever discipline they want to go in, even if it doesn't end up being a professionally qualified psychology discipline,
sentences.zh: 所以无论他们是谁，无论他们想进入哪个学科领域，即使最后没有成为专业资质的心理学领域，

sentences.en: I want them to love what they're doing and where they're at and to know that that's possible.
sentences.zh: 我也希望他们热爱自己所做的事和身处的环境，并知道这是可能的。

sentences.en: That's key.
sentences.zh: 这才是关键。

sentences.en: That's key.
sentences.zh: 这才是关键。

sentences.en: I think people coming into this profession have core values, don't they?
sentences.zh: 我觉得来到这个行业的人都有核心价值观，对吧？

sentences.en: Of compassion, of kindness, and wanting to connect with people.
sentences.zh: 那就是同情心、善良，以及想要与人建立连接的愿望。

sentences.en: And that's always got to feel good.
sentences.zh: 这始终得让人感觉良好。

sentences.en: I think that's always got to be a guiding force for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这应该永远是他们的指导力量。

sentences.en: So I agree.
sentences.zh: 所以我完全同意。

sentences.en: I think it's just about keep doing what feels good, keep doing what feels right.
sentences.zh: 我觉得就是坚持做那些感觉良好的事，坚持做那些感觉正确的事。

sentences.en: It's not always going to be a great, easy experience, as you all know.
sentences.zh: 正如大家所知，这并不总是一段美妙、轻松的经历。

sentences.en: But I think as long as you can keep checking in with whether it's in line with your values, with where you're at, that's the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 但我想，只要你能不断检查这是否符合你的价值观，是否契合你目前的处境，这就是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这样了。

sentences.en: And I feel like honestly, I could talk to you all day.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我觉得我可以跟你聊上一整天。

sentences.en: But time is slightly limited because of the podcaSt. Could you give us maybe your top tip for reducing burnout for aspiring psychologists, if that's okay?
sentences.zh: 但由于播客时间有限，能不能请你给立志成为心理学家的人分享一个减少职业倦怠的终极小建议呢？

sentences.en: Oh, gosh, top tip.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪，终极建议。

sentences.en: I for me, it always comes down to what I just said there with your values and being really connected to your current sense of identity and who you are and where you're at.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这总是归结为我刚才说的关于你的价值观，以及与你当前的自我认同感、你是谁以及你身处何方保持真正的连接。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people overstep that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多人忽略了这一点。

sentences.en: So we're so busy in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活太忙碌了。

sentences.en: We're so busy with the doing and the trying to reach the place that we think we should be at, that we don't often pause
sentences.zh: 我们忙于做事，忙于达到我们认为自己应该到达的高度，以至于我们没有经常驻足

sentences.en: enough with where we're at and reflect enough on that process and how that feels for us.
sentences.zh: 审视自己的现状，也没有对这个过程以及我们对此的感受进行足够的反思。

sentences.en: So doing a lot more of that really sitting with and really, really thinking about like, where am I feeling internally?
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要做更多的反思，真正静下心来，好好思考：我内心深处的感受是什么？

sentences.en: What are my values?
sentences.zh: 我的价值观是什么？

sentences.en: And what is happening around me to connect me to those values?
sentences.zh: 周围发生了什么让我与这些价值观保持连接？

sentences.en: Or what is pulling me away from those values?
sentences.zh: 或者是什么把我从这些价值观中拉开？

sentences.en: And what can I do to help myself feel more balanced with that?
sentences.zh: 我能做些什么来让自己在这方面感到更加平衡？

sentences.en: I think that's so, so crucial.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的、真的至关重要。

sentences.en: So a lot of just the sitting with the reflecting, and just kind of
sentences.zh: 所以，很多时候只需要静心反思，然后

sentences.en: encompassing all of that within compassion, because regardless of where you're at, there are going to be challenges.
sentences.zh: 把这一切都包容在同情心之中，因为无论你身处何地，都会面临挑战。

sentences.en: And if you can start to develop that compassionate voice within yourself, I think that's going to be one of the most important and most powerful tools you will take forward.
sentences.zh: 如果你能开始在内心培养那个充满同情心的声音，我认为这将是你未来随身携带的最重要、最强大的工具之一。

sentences.en: And I remember you saying actually, Marianne, I listened to one of your earlier podcasts, I'd be interested to know if this statistic has changed.
sentences.zh: 我记得你曾说过，玛丽安（Marian），我听了你早期的某个播客，我很想知道这个统计数据是否有变化。

sentences.en: But you said the self compassion one was the one that was downloaded the leaSt. And I find that so interesting, because that's the problem.
sentences.zh: 但你说关于自我同情的那一期是下载量最少的。我觉得这太有趣了，因为问题就出在这里。

sentences.en: We tend to overstep the stuff that's going to help us.
sentences.zh: 我们往往会忽视那些真正能帮助我们的东西。

sentences.en: So really, really do think about actually, what are you doing to tool yourself up in a very kind way that connects you to your values?
sentences.zh: 所以，真的、真的要好好想想，你究竟做了什么来以一种非常温和的方式武装自己，从而将你与你的价值观连接起来？

sentences.en: Really important.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要。

sentences.en: The yeah, the compassion, I think was one of the least three downloaded episodes.
sentences.zh: 是的，同情那一期，我想是下载量最少的最后三期之一。

sentences.en: So what I will do is I will seamlessly look at the look at the steps.
sentences.zh: 所以我要做的是，我会顺理成章地看看这些数据。

sentences.zh: 然后在录制这期的结束语时，我会把那个小谜题的答案告诉大家。

sentences.en: But yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 不过，真的谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's so important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: And it's, for me, it was the difference that made the difference.
sentences.zh: 对，对我来说，这就是带来改变的关键所在。

sentences.en: And I wish I'd picked up
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己能

sentences.en: literature on self compassion, whilst I was an aspiring psychologist, because I didn't discover it until I was qualified until I was a mother of two until my dad had died in 2008.
sentences.zh: 在我立志成为心理学家的时候就去阅读有关自我同情的文献，因为直到我获得资质、成为两个孩子的母亲、并且在2008年我父亲去世之后，我才发现它。

sentences.en: I think it was.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是那年吧。

sentences.en: And so, you know, just think about what a gentle journey I could have had on myself had I had self compassion in my world.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以想象，如果我的世界里早有自我同情，我的这段旅程该会有多么温柔。

sentences.en: That's perfect, because it's a journey either way, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这太完美了，因为不管怎样这都是一段旅程，不是吗？

sentences.en: So is it going to be a brutal, harsh one?
sentences.zh: 所以，它是会变得残酷而严苛呢？

sentences.en: Or is it one?
sentences.zh: 还是说……

sentences.en: Is it going to be one that actually can be quite compassionate with yourself about and actually just nurture yourself through because you will be growing and learning either way.
sentences.zh: 它会是一段你可以对自己充满同情、并借此温柔滋养自己度过的旅程？因为无论如何你都在成长和学习。

sentences.en: So I suppose it's that choice point that Ross Harris talks about.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是罗斯·哈里斯（Ross Harris）所说的那个抉择点。

sentences.en: And it's just deciding which way am I going to tackle this?
sentences.zh: 这只是在决定：我将如何应对这一切？

sentences.en: And how am I going to get myself through this?
sentences.zh: 我又将如何让自己度过难关？

sentences.en: Because you will get through one way or another.
sentences.zh: 因为无论如何你都会挺过去的。

sentences.en: You will.
sentences.zh: 你一定会的。

sentences.zh: 噢，非常感谢你，玛丽安。

sentences.zh: 和你聊天真的很轻松，我也很喜欢你在这里做的事。

sentences.zh: 所以当然，如果任何人有任何问题，随时可以联系我、找到我。

sentences.zh: 不管怎样，谢谢你邀请我来做客。

sentences.zh: 噢，我们还没聊到大家在哪里可以联系到你呢？

sentences.zh: 我们绝对应该聊聊这个。

sentences.zh: 真是不好意思。

sentences.zh: Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、Facebook 上搜索 Dr. Call Therapy 找到我。

sentences.zh: 太好了。
